rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your chipped mug, my ugly mug. I'll wash; you dry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bought a dishwasher.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You can hold the towels while it learns.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It dries them too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you can supervise your replacement.

card.title: Same Old Routine
card.instruction: Use familiar shorthand and old habits immediately, as though past routines still govern the present.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've knocked twice on your window. Ready for our usual walk?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I moved the doorbell so you wouldn't need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I'll ring it twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you text first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll text two knocks. You'll know it's me.

card.title: Same Old Routine
card.instruction: Use familiar shorthand and old habits immediately, as though past routines still govern the present.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home. That makes three lifts and a borrowed umbrella.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bought you coffee yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which covers the first roundabout.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said the lift was no trouble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct. Trouble is charged separately.

card.title: One More Favor
card.instruction: Treat every small request as part of a long-running balance sheet of favors, inconveniences, and repayments.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you water my plants? I covered your shift in March.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was one afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And these are only six small plants.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One is a tree.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shift included overtime.

card.title: One More Favor
card.instruction: Treat every small request as part of a long-running balance sheet of favors, inconveniences, and repayments.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've reminded you about the dentist tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's in my calendar.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll remind you to check the calendar.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It sends alerts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To which phone? The one you asked me to find?

card.title: The Designated Reminder
card.instruction: Keep track of what everyone was supposed to remember. Supply reminders before being asked and treat forgetfulness as your familiar burden.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bin day tomorrow. I've written it on your breakfast banana.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know when bin day is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why was last week's banana still in the fruit bowl?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wasn't hungry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Tomorrow's reminder goes on the coffee machine.

card.title: The Designated Reminder
card.instruction: Keep track of what everyone was supposed to remember. Supply reminders before being asked and treat forgetfulness as your familiar burden.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I carried the heavier shopping bag. Again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll carry it upstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll take the lighter one twice to keep things fair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can make one trip together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And erase the stair count? Convenient.

card.title: Keeping Score
card.instruction: Treat arrival times, effort, memory, and sacrifice as a running score you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I arrived ten minutes early to help set up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stayed an hour late yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Evenings count differently. Mine required getting out of bed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You live upstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which means I sacrificed a shorter commute.

card.title: Keeping Score
card.instruction: Treat arrival times, effort, memory, and sacrifice as a running score you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which counter takes these forms? Just checking they've not moved it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's been counter three for years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You remember.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were heading for the toilets.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Checking whether the signs still mislead newcomers.

card.title: You Know the System
card.instruction: Use another person’s knowledge of the routine while pretending you could manage perfectly well alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pass me the key for the shed. The one you think it is.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't know either?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm testing whether our systems agree.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Try the red one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Now remind me which shed we mean.

card.title: You Know the System
card.instruction: Use another person’s knowledge of the routine while pretending you could manage perfectly well alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's a sock on the stairs. We've reached this chapter again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I dropped it just now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And last month 'just now' lasted three days.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pick it up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before or after the usual promise about turning over a new leaf?

card.title: Still About Last Time
card.instruction: Treat each minor inconvenience as confirmation of an older grievance and the same recurring problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're five minutes late. So the old timetable's back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bus broke down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It always finds a supporting role in your apologies.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I walked the last mile.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then next time start walking before our agreed time.

card.title: Still About Last Time
card.instruction: Treat each minor inconvenience as confirmation of an older grievance and the same recurring problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Must be nice, cooking dinner in twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I chop the vegetables beforehand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely, having a life with 'beforehand' in it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can chop these now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. I'll briefly experience your advantages.

card.title: Must Be Nice
card.instruction: Treat another person’s ease with ordinary life as both inspiring and unfair. Copy their shortcuts while dismissing the advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your suitcase closes so easily. Some of us have real luggage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Try rolling your clothes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Must be nice, knowing tricks.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've rolled them. It's shut.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Well, obviously anything works under laboratory conditions.

card.title: Must Be Nice
card.instruction: Treat another person’s ease with ordinary life as both inspiring and unfair. Copy their shortcuts while dismissing the advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We used to arrange dinner by saying 'dinner?'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now we check six calendars.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I miss when hunger was our only app.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What time shall I put in?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put 'when we liked each other without passwords.'

card.title: We Used to Be Easy
card.instruction: Treat every practical difficulty as evidence that life, work, or this relationship used to be simpler.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our old shopping list just said bread, milk, eggs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now we have dietary requirements.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even the milk needs an interview.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Would you prefer to write the list?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I'll start with 'simpler times' and see which aisle.

card.title: We Used to Be Easy
card.instruction: Treat every practical difficulty as evidence that life, work, or this relationship used to be simpler.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could I get a lift? Only if starting the car isn't too much.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm already driving there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can get out before the traffic lights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's fine. Put your bag in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry it on my lap. No need to trouble the boot.

card.title: Don’t Be Difficult
card.instruction: Treat every request, correction, or small inconvenience as a warning that you are becoming too much trouble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could I have a clean fork? Sorry, this one's bent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll get another.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't cross the whole room for me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cutlery drawer's beside you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll use a spoon. Less disruption.

card.title: Don’t Be Difficult
card.instruction: Treat every request, correction, or small inconvenience as a warning that you are becoming too much trouble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed your cheese sandwich for the train.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was going to buy sushi.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What am I supposed to do with my researched cheese?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Eat it yourself?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I researched your preferences, not mine.

card.title: I Packed for You
card.instruction: Take care of practical needs before anyone asks, then resist choices that make your preparation unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take this raincoat. I checked the forecast all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's sunny.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The forecast wasn't always sunny.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can leave the coat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then seven days of preparation stays home alone.

card.title: I Packed for You
card.instruction: Take care of practical needs before anyone asks, then resist choices that make your preparation unnecessary.

transfer.action: I put {prop} between our two familiar chipped cups.
transfer.opening: Your side, my side. Same as always. {request}
transfer.response: Use the old signal; you know which part comes next. {counter}
transfer.challenge: We don't do it that way anymore.
transfer.closing: Our hands haven't heard the announcement yet.

transfer.action: I open my favour notebook beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I'll add this to the balance. {request}
transfer.response: I've kept the receipts for being agreeable. {counter}
transfer.closing: Only until generosity remembers how to travel both ways.

transfer.action: I pin a reminder to the reminder on {prop}.
transfer.response: I can set an alarm for your alarm. {counter}
transfer.closing: Excellent. I'll remind you that you said that tomorrow.

transfer.action: I put {prop} beside my tally of minutes, trips, and effort.
transfer.opening: Let's count whose share this really is. {request}
transfer.closing: Then you won't mind how carefully I've documented my lead.

transfer.action: I compare {prop} with your notes while pretending not to look.
transfer.opening: Just checking that you remember the routine. {request}
transfer.response: I'm comparing methods, not depending on yours. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You don't know how this works.
transfer.closing: I know exactly whose explanation will confirm my understanding.

transfer.action: I place {prop} beside last month's complaint.
transfer.response: I recognize where this is heading. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then give me one sentence we didn't use last time.

transfer.action: I copy your shortcut around {prop} with a resentful smile.
transfer.opening: Must be lovely having things just work. {request}
transfer.response: I'm testing whether your advantage works for the rest of us. {counter}
transfer.closing: And spoil the mystery of your wonderfully easy life?

transfer.action: I put {prop} beside our old three-item list.
transfer.opening: We used to do this without a spreadsheet. {request}
transfer.response: A knock on the door once counted as a plan. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then I miss how convincingly we pretended it was.

transfer.action: I move {prop} out of the way and make my request smaller.
transfer.response: I could take up less time. {counter}
transfer.closing: I know. I'm trying to use a very small amount of allowed.

transfer.action: I present {prop} from the bag I already packed for you.
transfer.response: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.
